notes: Neither data-name-1 nor record-key-name-1 shall be specified in more than one COLLATING SEQUENCE clause. The unit the rule counts is the CLAUSE: 12.4.5.7.2's Format-2 figure prints the ellipsis immediately right of the closing brace of { data-name-1 | record-key-name-1 }, so per 5.2.7 the repeated portion is the brace group and one clause may list the same key twice - one clause is never more than one.
